notes: One elongated rear platform is visible in both imagery years and corroborated by the laser plateau. It replaces two overlapping scorecard-axis rectangles.
The small forward platform at the old pad2 vicinity is partly covered by tree canopy/shadow in both years. Its full boundary is unresolved; old pad2 remains explicitly provisional.
The furthest short-tee card reference falls in the fairway; no separate physical deck is established there.
The two rear rectangles describe one continuous elongated mown platform. Its outer dark sloping collar is excluded.
The lower platform beside the rock is present, but its western edge is unclear in the imagery; old pad2 remains provisional.
Both rear candidate deck lobes are corroborated by terrain, but canopy and shadow hide their connecting and eastern material boundaries in both imagery years. No closed ring is adopted.

Old pad2 is a scorecard-axis rectangle within the continuous fairway. Neither 2024 nor 2025 shows a separate deck boundary; the terrain does not establish a distinct flat platform there. Retire only this unsupported pad footprint; its route and card reference remain untouched.
Four distinct mown turf tops are visible in both imagery years; the forward deck beside the lower path was absent from the model.
The traced turf tops exclude sloping mown shoulders. Existing daily/card marks are not used as polygon anchors.
The two southern rectangles describe one continuous irregular elongated platform. The third rectangle sits across the transition toward the separate round middle deck.
A fourth physical location, the forward oval beside the forked path, was absent. Three actual platform footprints replace the three axis rectangles; daily marker colours remain unresolved.
Two visible platforms along the walking route were absent: an elongated middle deck and a round forward deck.
Both old rear rectangles lie at one tree-shadowed rear tee complex whose full outer boundary is unresolved. Retain these two explicitly provisional footprints for this partial pass.
The most forward scorecard reference has no visibly distinct physical pad; no deck is invented at that point.

features.name: rear
features.method: Manual trace of the visible short-mown turf top on the 2025 orthophoto; reviewed at the identical EPSG:3006 crop in 2024. The darker sloping shoulder is excluded where visible. The published 1 m DTM corroborates plateau identity without determining material edges.
features.crosscheck: 2024 and 2025 show the same physical platform at this georeferenced location; no empirical absolute registration accuracy is claimed.

terrain.interpretation: A draining plane corroborates the traced turf top; it does not independently establish material boundaries. Original terrain must be preserved.

unresolvedCandidates.reason: Terrain plateau corroborates a possible deck, but eastern and southern material boundaries are hidden in both imagery years. No closed ring adopted.
A distinct lower deck is present beside the rock, but western and northern short-grass transitions are not resolved confidently in both captures. Old footprint retained provisionally.

Laser corroborates two rear plateau lobes; trees and shadow obscure the eastern edges and whether the short-mown turf is connected. Both existing guesses retained as provisional rather than closing hidden boundaries.

No discrete tee material boundary in 2024 or 2025; inferred rectangle is within continuous fairway. The source terrain at this location does not establish a separate flat tee deck. Retire unsupported rectangle while preserving card/route reference.
Rear tee complex exists, but its eastern material edge is hidden beneath tree shadow/canopy in both years. Existing two guesses retained provisionally.
Scorecard reference is in a mown corridor without an independently visible deck boundary. No new polygon inferred from a route marker.

notes: Accepted polygons identify physical turf surfaces, not daily tee-marker colours or scorecard endpoints.
The 2025 product year is advertised by the municipal Lantmäteriet viewing layer; exact flight dates and absolute horizontal accuracies were not provided.
Only derived vector evidence is committed; source rasters remain outside the repository. EPSG and source-pixel coordinate pairs are evidence only and must not be copied into runtime models.

terrainSource.method: geobuild/tee-platform-survey.mjs; native 1 m interior samples and least-squares drainage plane, separate 2 m eroded core when at least 12 samples survive
terrainSource.captureYearNote: Published Markhöjdmodell source year; this is separate from the 2024/2025 imagery dates.
terrainSource.accuracyNote: Product-advertised figures are not independent control residuals for the imagery or adopted polygons.
